_que_es: Insignias de BadgeConfig (2026-11-02): imagen de 512x512 para cada una, recortada en círculo por Roblox. python tools/storeart.py base skills/_shared/tienda/recetas/insignias.json --out base.png; python tools/imagegen.py generate skills/_shared/tienda/recetas/insignias.json --ref base.png --quality high --n 1 --out <carpeta>; python tools/storeart.py finish skills/_shared/tienda/recetas/insignias.json --sheet <hoja>.png --out assets/ui/badge-art.

ia.prompt: Keep the same 9 tiles, in this order: 1) welcome: a big shiny golden star with a happy sparkle on a tile of the same color as the draft, 2) first_rare: a blue spotted rare egg with a soft glowing aura on a tile of the same color as the draft, 3) secret: a black egg with glowing rainbow spots and a rainbow aura on a tile of the same color as the draft, 4) rebirth: two thick circular arrows, blue and pink, with sparkles on a tile of the same color as the draft, 5) collector: a blue book with a golden star on the cover and sparkles on a tile of the same color as the draft, 6) streak: a calendar with a golden star and a small orange flame on a tile of the same color as the draft, 7) playtime: a red alarm clock with golden sparkles on a tile of the same color as the draft, 8) friends: two smiling friend heads, blue and green, side by side on a tile of the same color as the draft, 9) met_dev: a golden crown with a small silver hammer and wrench crossed in front on a tile of the same color as the draft. Keep each object well inside the center, Roblox shows badges cropped to a circle.
